name: Tau Fire Warrior Strike Team

loreStats.armorComposition: Nanocrystalline Bonded Ceramic-Plasteel Composite Combat Armor
loreStats.citation: Codex: Tau Empire (9th Ed), Peter Fehervari - Fire Caste (2013)
loreStats.loreSummary: Disciplined ranged combat infantry of the Fire Caste. Equipped with advanced sensor suites, target-lock optics, and devastating long-range pulse rifles that generate contained plasma bolts.

tacticalDescription: Superior long-range fire infantry. Highest non-heavy ballistic range and thermal energy output among core line infantry, vulnerable to close melee charges.
